observations.behavior: Adds a beta status banner and feedback button to Business Knowledge scene.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users of this specific feature area to opt-in/opt-out and provide feedback without changing backend behavior.

observations.behavior: Conditionally adds an AI support feedback banner only when AI features are enabled for that user.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides targeted feedback collection for AI-dependent workflows while preserving compatibility with non-AI users.

observations.limitations: Changes are limited to adding UI banners; no changes to query execution, ingestion, identity storage, or shared infrastructure. No tests or migration helpers shown in chunk.

review.limitations: Changes are limited to adding UI banners; no changes to query execution, ingestion, identity storage, or shared infrastructure. No tests or migration helpers shown in chunk.
review.reason: These hunks demonstrate narrow, localized maintenance and UX additions: inserting two informational banners into existing scenes. The implementation does not change core capabilities, correctness, reliability, or systemic risk reduction. Tier 1 is appropriate because the benefit is bounded to these pages and relies on unverified external configuration (survey IDs).
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant as it could help PostHog collect qualitative feedback from early adopters of Business Knowledge and AI Support, potentially informing future development priorities.
review.uncertainty: The actual survey destinations and whether they represent a broader product initiative are unknown; tier cannot be raised without evidence of wider impact.
